items.title: Abbott (ABT) Stock May Be 28% Undervalued Despite AI Testing Expansion
items.summary: Abbott Laboratories has seen its share price under pressure over the past year, which puts fresh attention on what investors are really paying for in terms of its future cash flows. With the stock closing at US$107.45 most recently, the key issue is how that market tag lines up with what the business can generate in hard cash over time. items.title: Is A Medicare Delay The Biggest Risk For DexCom Stock?
items.summary: DexCom (DXCM) owners have one dated question left for 2026: will Medicare agree to pay for glucose monitors for people with type 2 diabetes who are not on insulin? DexCom said on its call after Q3 results that it expects CMS to announce that coverage decision this year, with DexCom's current plan assuming coverage takes effect in the middle of 2027.
